name: A skipped seq is logged, accepted, and resets anchor confidence
description: A named pipe does not lose messages in transit, so a gap means the sender skipped numbers or dropped its own output. It is not fatal - refusing the text would be worse than accepting it - but the client has provably missed hypotheses, so any anchor confidence derived from commit differencing is no longer trustworthy and is reset.
